summary: Read each message's canonical ordering key in one SQL lookup instead of two

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild is introduced.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger or version changes.

rules.detail: Canonical ordering, checkpoint rules and ownership policy are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Valid message views and their full canonical order are preserved. The earliest sent or desired claim is selected before joining its batch; a missing batch remains an error. A corrupt non-text claim ID still refuses, but its SQLite diagnostic names column 5 rather than the old column 0; identical diagnostics for every corruption are not claimed. No client or wire changes.

downtime.detail: No added interruption or migration. One canonical-key SQL lookup per returned message is removed; CPU savings, incident onset and dominant cost are unmeasured.

recovery.detail: This read-path change writes no persisted state; reverting source restores the two-lookup reader without a data migration.
